questions.question: GitOps nima (CD kontekstida)?
questions.explanation: Git repo deklarativ infra va deploy uchun yagona haqiqat manbai; klaster ichidagi operator'lar pull asosida avtomatik reconcile qiladi.

questions.question: GitOps'ning to'rt tamoyili (OpenGitOps) qanday?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ desired state, 2. Git'da versiyalangan va o'zgarmas, 3. Klaster ichidagi agent avtomatik pull qiladi, 4. Uzluksiz reconcile va drift'ni avtomatik tuzatish.

questions.question: ArgoCD nima va qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes uchun deklarativ GitOps operatori: Git repo'larni kuzatadi va klasterning live holatini desired state bilan sinxronlaydi.

questions.question: ArgoCD Application CRD nima?
questions.explanation: Ilova uchun source repo, path, target klaster, namespace va sync policy'ni belgilaydigan Custom Resource.

questions.question: ArgoCD ApplicationSet nima?
questions.explanation: List, Cluster, Git directory yoki Matrix generator'lar bilan ko'plab Application resurslarini avtomatik yaratib, ko'p klasterga deploy qiluvchi controller.

questions.question: ArgoCD sync wave'lari nima?
questions.explanation: argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "1" annotation — sinxronlash paytida resurslar qo'llanish tartibini raqam bilan boshqaradi (kichik/manfiy avval).

questions.question: ArgoCD sync phase'lari nima?
questions.explanation: PreSync → Sync → PostSync → SyncFail. Hook'lar bilan deploy'dan oldin prerequisite job'lar (DB migration) ishga tushiriladi.

questions.question: ArgoCD auto-sync va self-heal nima?
questions.explanation: Auto-sync yangi Git commit'larni avtomatik qo'llaydi; self-heal klasterdagi qo'lda (out-of-band) o'zgarishlarni aniqlab, Git holatiga qaytaradi.

questions.question: ArgoCD prune nima?
questions.explanation: Manifest Git'dan o'chirilganda mos resursni klasterdan ham o'chiradigan sync sozlamasi (default o'chiq — ehtiyot uchun).

questions.question: FluxCD tarkibi qanday?
questions.explanation: GitOps'ni amalga oshiruvchi controller'lar to'plami: Source Controller, Kustomize Controller, Helm Controller, Notification va Image Automation.

questions.question: FluxCD Kustomization CRD nima?
questions.explanation: Git'dan Kustomize overlay'larini klasterga qo'llash pipeline'i — health check, prune va dependency (dependsOn) bilan.

questions.question: FluxCD HelmRelease nima?
questions.explanation: Helm chart reliz lifecycle'ini deklarativ boshqaradi: chart'ni OCI/HTTP repo'dan oladi, values'ni reconcile qiladi, xatoda remediation (rollback).

questions.question: Progressive delivery nima?
questions.explanation: Canary, trafik routing, feature flag va avtomatik metrika tahlilini birlashtirgan ilg'or CD — reliz paytida blast radius minimal.

questions.question: Argo Rollouts qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Standart Deployment o'rniga Rollout CRD: canary trafik bo'lish va avtomatik metrika tahlilini muvofiqlashtiradi.

questions.question: Argo Rollouts'da AnalysisTemplate nima?
questions.explanation: Canary sog'ligini baholash uchun Prometheus, Datadog yoki CloudWatch so'rovlari va muvaffaqiyat shartini belgilaydigan deklarativ shablon.

questions.question: Flagger qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) va Ingress controller'lar bilan canary, A/B test va blue-green'ni avtomatlashtiradi; mavjud Deployment'ni o'rab oladi.

questions.question: Software supply chain security nima?
questions.explanation: Butun dasturiy ta'minot sikli bo'ylab ruxsatsiz o'zgarish, zararli dependency kiritish va buzilgan build tizimlaridan himoya.

questions.question: SLSA darajalari (1–3) qanday?
questions.explanation: L1: provenance yaratuvchi skriptli build; L2: imzolangan provenance bilan hosted build servisi; L3: izolyatsiyalangan, ephemeral build platforma, soxtalashtirib bo'lmaydigan provenance.

questions.question: Cosign bilan keyless signing qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: OIDC token Fulcio'da qisqa muddatli X.509 sertifikatga almashtiriladi, image u bilan imzolanadi va imzo Rekor transparency log'ga yoziladi.

questions.question: Sigstore'da Rekor nima?
questions.explanation: Imzolangan artifact metadata'si va provenance isbotini yozadigan o'zgarmas, append-only transparency log.

questions.question: Sigstore'da Fulcio nima?
questions.explanation: OIDC identity'ga (masalan GitHub Actions workflow) bog'langan qisqa muddatli (~10 daqiqa) X.509 sertifikat beradigan bepul public CA.

questions.question: Syft nima?
questions.explanation: Image, fayl tizimi va arxivlardan CycloneDX/SPDX formatida SBOM yaratadigan CLI va kutubxona.

questions.question: Grype nima?
questions.explanation: Container image va SBOM fayllarini ma'lum zaifliklarga skanerlovchi ochiq kodli scanner.

questions.question: In-toto nima?
questions.explanation: Supply chain yaxlitligini kriptografik tekshirish framework'i: commit → build → packaging har qadami ruxsatli aktor tomonidan bajarilganini isbotlaydi.

questions.question: Kyverno image verification nima?
questions.explanation: Admission policy: pod schedule qilinishidan oldin image'ning Cosign imzosini tekshiradi; imzosizlarni rad etadi.

questions.question: Bitnami Sealed Secrets nima?
questions.explanation: Secret client tomonda public key bilan shifrlanib Git'ga commit qilinadi; klaster ichidagi controller private key bilan ochib oddiy Secret yaratadi.

questions.question: External Secrets Operator (ESO) nima?
questions.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, Azure Key Vault kabi tashqi vault'lardan secret'larni native Kubernetes Secret ga sinxronlaydigan operator.

questions.question: Vault Agent Sidecar Injector nima?
questions.explanation: Mutating webhook: pod'ga Vault agent container'ini qo'shadi, u secret'larni dinamik olib in-memory volume'ga render qiladi.

questions.question: Terraform uchun Atlantis nima?
questions.explanation: PR izohlari orqali terraform plan va apply ni bajaradigan ochiq kodli ilova; avtomatik state/directory locking bilan.

questions.question: Spacelift nima?
questions.explanation: IaC (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Kubernetes) uchun maxsus CI/CD platforma, OPA bilan policy enforcement.

questions.question: ARC (Actions Runner Controller) autoscaling qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Runner pod'lari GitHub API metrikasi (workflow_job navbati) asosida 0 dan yuzlabgacha dinamik scale qilinadi.

questions.question: Ephemeral runner xavfsizligi nima?
questions.explanation: Self-hosted runner pod/VM bitta job tugashi bilan yo'q qilinadi — lateral movement, credential o'g'irlash va holat ifloslanishining oldi olinadi.

questions.question: Snyk nima?
questions.explanation: Kod (SAST), dependency (SCA), container image va IaC shablonlarini zaifliklarga skanerlovchi tijoriy developer security platformasi.

questions.question: SonarQube nima?
questions.explanation: Coverage, dublikat, murakkablik, code smell va xavfsizlik zaifliklarini baholovchi uzluksiz kod sifati platformasi.

questions.question: CI/CD'da OWASP ZAP nima?
questions.explanation: Pipeline'da avtomatik DAST bajaradigan ochiq kodli web ilova xavfsizlik skaneri.

questions.question: Checkov nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform, Kubernetes manifest, Helm chart va Dockerfile'larni xavfsizlik misconfiguration'lariga skanerlovchi IaC statik tahlil tool'i.

questions.question: tfsec nima?
questions.explanation: Terraform kodi uchun tez statik xavfsizlik skaneri; hozir Trivy'ga birlashtirilgan.

questions.question: Infracost nima?
questions.explanation: PR'dagi Terraform kodini tahlil qilib, merge'dan oldin oylik cloud xarajat ta'sirini hisoblaydigan FinOps tool.

questions.question: GitOps'da Kustomize nima?
questions.explanation: Shablonsiz konfiguratsiya menejeri: base konfiguratsiya ustiga deklarativ overlay'lar (dev, staging, prod) bilan YAML'ni moslaydi (kubectl apply -k).

questions.question: GitOps'da Helm nima?
questions.explanation: Kubernetes paket menejeri: bog'liq manifest'larni values.yaml bilan parametrlanadigan qayta ishlatiluvchi Chart'larga jamlaydi.

questions.question: Helmfile nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta Helm chart'ni bir nechta klasterga dependency tartibida deploy qilish uchun deklarativ spetsifikatsiya.

questions.question: Tekton Pipelines nima?
questions.explanation: Ephemeral pod'larda ketma-ket yoki parallel bajariladigan Task'lardan iborat DAG'ni belgilovchi Kubernetes-native CRD.

questions.question: Spinnaker Kayenta (Automated Canary Analysis) nima?
questions.explanation: Canary metrikalarini baseline bilan vaqt bo'yicha statistik solishtirib, avtomatik promote/rollback qaror qiladigan engine.

questions.question: CI/CD'da Chaos Mesh nima?
questions.explanation: Pipeline paytida staging'ga tarmoq kechikishi, pod nosozligi va disk stress kiritib, resilience'ni tekshirish.

questions.question: Semantic Release nima?
questions.explanation: Commit xabarlaridan keyingi SemVer versiyani aniqlaydi, changelog, Git tag yaratadi va relizni publish qiladi.

questions.question: Release Please nima?
questions.explanation: Google tool'i: conventional commit tarixiga ko'ra changelog va versiya oshirilgan "Release PR" yaratadi; PR merge bo'lganda reliz chiqadi.

questions.question: Dependabot / Renovate nima?
questions.explanation: Repo manifest'larini skanerlab, yangi paket versiyalari uchun changelog bilan avtomatik PR ochadigan bot'lar.

questions.question: Renovate bot'ning afzalligi nima?
questions.explanation: Juda moslashuvchan, ko'p platformali; guruhlash, jadval va buzmaydigan (patch/security) yangilanishlarni avtomatik merge qilishni qo'llaydi.

questions.question: Pull request builder job nima?
questions.explanation: PR yaratilganda/yangilanganda build, test qilib, natijani PR'ga status check sifatida qaytaradigan CI job.

questions.question: GitOps'da out-of-sync holat nima?
questions.explanation: Klasterdagi resurslarning live holati Git'da e'lon qilingan konfiguratsiyadan farq qiladigan holat.

questions.question: GitOps drift correction nima?
questions.explanation: Klasterdagi ruxsatsiz qo'lda o'zgarishlarni avtomatik ravishda Git'dagi versiyaga qaytarish.

questions.question: ArgoCD PreSync hook nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa resurslardan oldin bajariladigan resurs (odatda Job) — ko'pincha DB schema migration uchun.

questions.question: ArgoCD PostSync hook nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha resurslar healthy bo'lgandan keyingina bajariladigan Job (smoke test, bildirishnoma).

questions.question: ArgoCD SyncFail hook nima?
questions.explanation: Sinxronlash yiqilganda bajariladigan remediation Job.

questions.question: Secret masking'ni chetlab o'tish xavfi nima?
questions.explanation: Secret base64'langan, bo'lingan yoki o'zgartirilgan bo'lsa CI engine uni tanimaydi va log'da ochiq chiqaradi. Masking — oxirgi himoya chizig'i, asosiysi emas.

questions.question: CI'da Git credential helper nima?
questions.explanation: Runner'ga remote Git'ga hardcode parol emas, qisqa muddatli OAuth token bilan autentifikatsiya qilish imkonini beruvchi utilita.

questions.question: Reusable workflow'da `secrets: inherit` nima?
questions.explanation: Chaqiruvchi workflow'ning barcha secret'larini reusable workflow'ga uzatadi (qulay, lekin least privilege'ga zid).

questions.question: Container layer squashing nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha oraliq layer'larni bittaga birlashtirib image hajmini kamaytirish va vaqtinchalik fayllarni tashlash (layer cache'dan foydalanish yo'qoladi; odatda multi-stage yaxshiroq).

questions.question: Multi-arch container build nima?
questions.explanation: docker buildx bilan bitta Dockerfile'dan bir nechta arxitektura (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) uchun image va manifest list yaratish.

questions.question: OCI (Open Container Initiative) nima?
questions.explanation: Container image formati (Image Spec), runtime (Runtime Spec) va registry API (Distribution Spec) standartlarini belgilovchi ochiq tashkilot.

questions.question: Cosign attestation nima?
questions.explanation: Metadata predicate'larini (SBOM, test natijalari, scan hisobotlari) kriptografik imzolab, registry'da image'ga biriktirish.

questions.question: Kyverno `ClusterPolicy` va `Policy` farqi.
questions.explanation: ClusterPolicy butun klasterga; Policy faqat bitta namespace'ga tegishli.

questions.question: OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate nima?
questions.explanation: Siyosatning Rego logikasini belgilovchi CRD; Constraint resurslari uni parametrlar bilan instansiyalaydi.

questions.question: CI feedback loop nima?
questions.explanation: Commit push'dan test natijasini olgunga qadar vaqt; yuqori tezlik uchun 10 daqiqadan kam bo'lishi kerak.

questions.question: Monorepo incremental building nima?
questions.explanation: Cache'langan compile natijalari bilan bitta fayl o'zgarsa faqat u va unga bevosita bog'liqlar qayta build qilinadi.

questions.question: Bazel nima?
questions.explanation: Google'ning tez, scale qiladigan ko'p tilli build tizimi: hermetic, reproducible build va agressiv (remote) caching.

questions.question: Turborepo nima?
questions.explanation: JS/TS monorepo'lar uchun build va test natijalarini remote cache'laydigan yuqori unumdor build tizimi.

questions.question: Nx nima?
questions.explanation: Monorepo uchun dependency graph vizualizatsiyasi va distributed task execution'ga ega kengaytiriladigan build framework.

questions.question: Git pre-commit hook nima?
questions.explanation: git commit dan oldin lokal avtomatik ishlaydigan client skript — lint, format va secret tekshiruvi. Majburiy emas (--no-verify), shuning uchun CI'da ham takrorlang.

questions.question: `pre-commit` framework nima?
questions.explanation: Deklarativ .pre-commit-config.yaml orqali pre-commit hook'larni boshqaradigan ko'p tilli paket menejeri.

questions.question: Trunk-based'da feature flag lifecycle qanday?
questions.explanation: Flag yaratish → 2. Logikani flag ortida yozish → 3. main ga merge → 4. Prod'da yoqish → 5. Flag shart kodini tozalash.

questions.question: Dark launching va shadowing farqi.
questions.explanation: Dark launching — UI o'zgarishsiz backend kodni chiqarish; shadowing (mirroring) — jonli kiruvchi trafikni nusxalab yangi versiyaga ham yuborish (javobi foydalanuvchiga qaytmaydi).

questions.question: Artifact provenance hujjati nima?
questions.explanation: Artifact'ni kim, qaysi commit SHA'dan, qaysi runner'da, qaysi parametrlar bilan build qilganini yozadigan kriptografik imzolangan metadata.

questions.question: CycloneDX nima?
questions.explanation: OWASP qo'llaydigan yengil SBOM standarti — application security va zaiflik tahlili uchun.

questions.question: SPDX nima?
questions.explanation: SBOM ma'lumotini (komponentlar, litsenziyalar, copyright) uzatish uchun ochiq standart (ISO/IEC 5962:2021).

questions.question: VEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) nima?
questions.explanation: SBOM'ga hamroh mashina o'qiy oladigan hujjat: dependency'dagi aniq CVE bu ilovada haqiqatda exploit qilinadimi yoki yo'q — scan shovqinini kamaytiradi.

questions.question: SLSA provenance nima?
questions.explanation: Build paytida yaratiladigan in-toto attestation — source repo, commit va build muhitini tasdiqlaydi.

questions.question: Docker Content Trust (DCT) nima?
questions.explanation: Notary va raqamli imzolar bilan image tag'ining yaxlitligi va publisher'ini tekshiradigan eski Docker funksiyasi (bugun Cosign/Notation afzal).

questions.question: Pipeline deadlock nima?
questions.explanation: Ikki yoki undan ko'p job o'zaro bog'liq resurs/lock'larni cheksiz kutishi (A lock 1 ni ushlab B ni kutadi, B lock 2 ni ushlab A ni kutadi).

questions.question: CI/CD pipeline blast radius nima?
questions.explanation: CI/CD tizimi buzilsa yetkazilishi mumkin bo'lgan maksimal zarar; pull-based GitOps (prod credential CI'da yo'q) va ephemeral runner'lar bilan kamaytiriladi.

questions.question: Argo Rollouts'da avtomatik rollback qanday?
questions.explanation: AnalysisTemplate metrikasi chegarani buzsa canary avtomatik abort qilinadi va trafik stable pod'larga qaytariladi.

questions.question: Canary step weight nima?
questions.explanation: Progressive rollout'ning ma'lum bosqichida canary'ga ajratilgan trafik foizi (setWeight: 20).

questions.question: Flagger MetricTemplate nima?
questions.explanation: Canary tahlilida tekshiriladigan PromQL so'rovlarini (error rate < 1%, latency < 500ms) belgilovchi CRD.

questions.question: Blue-green cutover latency nima?
questions.explanation: Load balancer yoki DNS routing'ni Blue'dan Green'ga yangilashga ketgan vaqt; Kubernetes Service selector bilan soniyadan kam, DNS bilan esa TTL'ga bog'liq.

questions.question: Pipeline concurrency lock nima?
questions.explanation: Har target muhit uchun bir vaqtda faqat bitta deploy pipeline bajarilishi — bir-birining ustiga tushadigan holat o'zgarishlarining oldini olish.

questions.question: GitOps sync window nima?
questions.explanation: ArgoCD'da avtomatik sinxronlashni ma'lum soatlarda ruxsat beruvchi yoki taqiqlovchi jadval (masalan dam olish kunlari prod sync yo'q).

questions.question: ArgoCD SSO nima?
questions.explanation: ArgoCD'ni Okta, Azure AD, GitHub kabi IdP bilan OIDC/SAML orqali integratsiyalash va RBAC'ni majburlash.

questions.question: FluxCD Source Controller nima?
questions.explanation: Git repo, Helm chart va S3 bucket'larni kuzatib, boshqa controller'lar uchun artifact arxivlarini tayyorlaydigan controller.

questions.question: FluxCD Kustomize Controller nima?
questions.explanation: Source Controller artifact'idan Kustomize orqali manifest generatsiya qilib klasterga qo'llaydigan controller.

questions.question: FluxCD Notification Controller nima?
questions.explanation: Git provayderlardan kiruvchi webhook'larni qabul qiladi va Slack, Teams, Discord'ga hodisa bildirishnomalarini yuboradi.

questions.question: Tekton PipelineRun nima?
questions.explanation: Pipeline ni aniq parametr va workspace'lar bilan klasterda instansiyalab bajaradigan CR.

questions.question: Tekton TaskRun nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta Task ni ketma-ket container step'lardan iborat pod ichida bajaradigan CR.

questions.question: GitLab CI'da matrix job nima?
questions.explanation: parallel: matrix: bilan belgilangan o'zgaruvchilar kombinatsiyalari bo'yicha job variantlarini parallel ishga tushirish.

questions.question: Secrets Store CSI Driver nima?
questions.explanation: Vault'dagi secret'larni Kubernetes Secret obyekti yaratmasdan pod'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri in-memory fayl sifatida mount qilish.

questions.question: CI/CD'da zero-downtime DB migration ketma-ketligi qanday?
questions.explanation: Nullable ustunlar qo'shish (expand), 2. Eski va yangi ustunga yozadigan ilova, 3. Backfill, 4. Yangi ustundan o'qiydigan ilova, 5. Eski ustunni o'chirish (contract).

questions.question: In-tree va out-of-tree CI plugin farqi.
questions.explanation: In-tree — asosiy CI engine'ga compile qilingan; out-of-tree — runtime'da dinamik yuklanadigan tashqi community action'lar (supply chain xavfi yuqoriroq).

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da action pinning nima?
questions.explanation: Third-party action'larni o'zgaruvchan tag (@v4) emas, to'liq commit SHA bilan qotirish (uses: actions/setup-node@60edb5...) — tag qayta yozilib zararli kod kiritilishidan himoya.

questions.question: Kaniko bilan hermetic container build nima?
questions.explanation: Image build'ni host Docker socket'i mount qilinmagan izolyatsiyalangan pod'da bajarib, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri OCI registry'ga push qilish.

questions.question: Pipeline flakiness rate nima?
questions.explanation: Kod xatosi emas, beqaror test yoki tarmoq timeout'lari sababli yiqilgan run'lar foizi — dasturchilar ishonchini yemiradi; flaky test'larni kuzatib tuzatish kerak.

questions.question: Progressive delivery'da avtomatik metrika gating nima?
questions.explanation: Canary paytida real vaqt golden signal telemetriyasini baholab, inson aralashuvisiz relizni promote yoki abort qilish.
